title: Comprehensive Privacy Notice
intro: This document constitutes the legal commitment of Hericraft Soluciones Integrales en Educación 4.0 to protect the digital sovereignty of its users.

sections.gobernanza: IV. DIGITAL GOVERNANCE AND THIRD PARTIES
sections.seguridad: V. SHIELDING AND SECURITY (THE DEFENSE SECTION)
sections.derechos: VI. RIGHTS AND DATA LIFE CYCLE

content.identidad_titulo: Identity and address of the responsible party
content.identidad_texto: Hericraft Soluciones Integrales en Educación 4.0 (hereinafter, "THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY"), with legal address in the city of Aguascalientes, Ags., Mexico, is the owner and responsible for the processing of your personal data in the digital ecosystem comprising the College by Hericraft learning platform and the College Store online store.
content.glosario_plataforma: Platform: The digital environment (web and app) where College by Hericraft and College Store operate.
content.glosario_snap: SNAP Ecosystem: Navigation, Learning and Praxis System; proprietary architecture of Hericraft that processes pedagogical progress.
content.glosario_biometricos: Biometric learning data: Information derived from physical or behavioral traits (e.g., interaction patterns or facial recognition for exam validation) that uniquely identify the student.
content.glosario_licencia: License: Temporary and non-exclusive right to use digital content within the platform.
content.categorias_desc: For the optimal functioning of Education 5.0, we classify data into:
content.categorias_identificacion_ejemplos: Name, nickname, email, physical address (for shipments).
content.categorias_academicos_ejemplos: Educational level, progress in the SNAP Core, peer evaluations.
content.categorias_metadatos_ejemplos: IP address, time spent, device type.
content.categorias_financieros_ejemplos: Tax ID, billing information (payments are processed by third parties).
content.finalidades_necesarias: Necessary (Service): Profile management, delivery of College Store products, issuance of certificates, and technical support.
content.finalidades_marketing: Marketing (Optional): Sending promotions and Education 5.0 newsletters. The user may revoke this consent at any time.
content.ia_titulo: Use of artificial intelligence and algorithms
content.ia_texto1: THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY uses artificial intelligence engines to analyze student progress within the College by Hericraft platform. These algorithms:
content.ia_lista1: Personalize the learning path according to performance.
content.ia_lista2: Do not create discriminatory profiles or sell this information to third parties.
content.ia_texto2: Processing is automated, but the user has the right to request a human review of academic results if deemed necessary.
content.ia_texto3: For the proper functioning of the SNAP Core, we collect interaction metadata (response times, click patterns, navigation) to detect levels of pedagogical stress or frustration. This data is processed under strict security measures and its sole purpose is to allow preventive human intervention by the teacher.
content.menores_texto: Since we interact with minors (Primary to High School), registration requires:
content.menores_lista1: Tutor validation: The parent or guardian must confirm the account through a two-factor mechanism (email/SMS) or simple digital signature.
content.menores_lista2: Privacy by design: Minors' data are subject to a higher logical isolation, preventing them from being indexed by external search engines.
content.consentimiento_tacito: Tacit: By browsing and using free functions.
content.consentimiento_expreso: Express: When making a purchase at College Store or formally registering at College by Hericraft by checking the box "I accept the Privacy Notice".
content.transferencias_texto: Your data resides on high-security servers operated by Google Cloud / Firebase, which may be located in the US or other regions. These transfers are made under standard contractual clauses that guarantee a level of protection equivalent to Mexican law.
content.terceros_pagos: Payments: Financial transactions are carried out via Stripe or PayPal. THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY does not store or know your credit card data.
content.terceros_logistica: Logistics: For physical shipments, we share name and address with courier companies (e.g., FedEx, DHL), who act as data processors.
content.medidas_texto: We implement AES-256 encryption, SSL/HTTPS protocols, and periodic vulnerability audits.
content.fuerza_mayor_texto: Despite having state-of-the-art measures, the user acknowledges that no platform is 100% invulnerable. THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY will not be liable for damages arising from:
content.fuerza_mayor_lista1: Zero-day attacks: Software vulnerabilities unknown to the manufacturer at the time of the attack.
content.fuerza_mayor_lista2: Third-party interference: Massive hacks that exceed current industrial security standards, provided THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY demonstrates that it has applied the relevant security updates.
content.data_breach_texto: In the event of a confirmed breach, THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY will notify users and the competent authority (INAI) within no more than 72 hours, detailing the mitigation measures adopted.
content.arco_texto: You may exercise your rights of Access, Rectification, Cancellation or Opposition by sending a request to:
content.retencion_titulo: Retention and deletion: They are kept while the account is active for certification purposes.
content.retencion_academicos: Academic data: Retained while the account is active for certification purposes.
content.retencion_comerciales: Commercial data: Retained for 5 years to comply with tax obligations.
content.retencion_olvido: Right to be forgotten: After account cancellation, data will be blocked and subsequently deleted through secure deletion methods after 12 months of total inactivity.
content.cookies_texto: We use cookies to remember your session and analyze traffic. You can manage them from your browser settings, although disabling them could limit learning functions.
content.autoridad_texto: For any controversy, the user may go to the National Institute for Transparency, Access to Information and Personal Data Protection (INAI) in Mexico.
content.cambios_texto: Any modification will be notified through a banner on the Platform. Continued use of the services after notification constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
content.nota: Hericraft Note: This notice is a transparency tool. We recommend a full reading to understand how technology and pedagogy converge safely.
